description: Ministry of Digital Infrastructure & Information Technology - Regulations under the Electronic Transaction Act, No. 19 of 2006. Amendment to (e-population Register) Regulations
categorisation: This gazette content contains regulations made by the Minister under the Electronic Transactions Act, No. 19 of 2006, specifically amending the Electronic Transactions (e-Population Register) Regulations. It deals with legal/regulatory matters including statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation, which falls under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). The content does not primarily concern government structure/personnel, land, commercial, elections, public service, judicial, or other specialized categories.
